dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The tragic death of my beloved daughter, Huachu, has shattered my heart into a thousand pieces! I am now selling this property so that I can give her the funeral she deserves."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "This magnificent building was once home to the Minghua Bank. It is spacious, enjoys plenty of natural light, and comes with a fantastic sea view. It is being sold for purely financial reasons, and I hope that the new owner makes good use of it."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Interested parties may contact Gentry De'an at Chihu Rock."
